text:
Type: flanged cotton cushion
Use: comfort and decoration on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: sturdy woven cotton canvas, flat flange border, hidden zipper
Colors: warm beige, sand
Shape: square plain cushion with a flat flanged edge around all four sides, smooth tight weave, plump and simple, medium size
Feel: calm, neutral, soft, easygoing
Goes with: grey, white or brown sofas, light wood, other solid or patterned cushions; Scandinavian, minimalist or contemporary living rooms
